rows.label: Detonite Injector
rows.alt: Orb Vallis Lvl 30-50 bounty: 2, 33.33% stage 1, 20% stages 2-3, 16.67% stage 4

conditions: Invasions don't always have a Grineer side, and the Fortuna bounty pays injectors only when its rotating reward is Detonite.
bonuses: On a Detonite Fortuna bounty, finish stage 1 then quit and retake it; one player made 32-40 injectors an hour. The Blood Relics bounty opens with caches, which clear fastest.

disclosures.title: building injectors
disclosures.body: Each needs a single-use 15,000 cr Chem Lab blueprint, then 15,000 cr, 10 Detonite Ampule, 1 Control Module, 500 Salvage and 250 Plastids, 12 hours. Five cost 150,000 cr, 50 Ampules and 1,250 Plastids. Ampules drop in Grineer Dark Sector Survivals like Piscinas, Saturn and Gabii, Ceres. Queueing them from the companion app costs no play time, but watch your Plastids.

bonuses: The Vulcan Blitz mod works only on this weapon, but Mastery doesn't need it.
